requirement.normalizedRequirement: For linear structural calculations: web plates and flange elements in compression and shear shall meet the applicable buckling criteria; nominal shear stress in member webs shall be less than sigma_y/sqrt(3); and nominal von Mises stress in member flanges shall be less than 1.15*sigma_y.
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: For linear calculation methods: web plates and flange elements in compression and shear are to fulfil the relevant buckling criteria specified by the Classification Society; nominal shear stress in member web plates is to be less than sigma_y/sqrt(3); and nominal von Mises stress in member flanges is to be less than 1.15*sigma_y.
